body.heading: Where in the world is United Arab Emirates?
paragraphs: United Arab Emirates is a country in Western Asia, which is part of Asia.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of United Arab Emirates is Abu Dhabi.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in United Arab Emirates is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of United Arab Emirates is the UAE dirham.

body.heading: How big is United Arab Emirates?
paragraphs: United Arab Emirates covers about 84,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Cambodia.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the world’s tallest completed building. The Burj Khalifa is so tall that people on its highest floors can watch the sun set twice — once at the bottom, then again at the top.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: The Burj Khalifa is the tallest building on Earth at 828 metres. Ride one of the world's fastest elevators to its observation decks and look down on the whole city.
Abu Dhabi's Grand Mosque is a white-marble wonder of domes, reflecting pools and the world's largest hand-knotted carpet — it glows at sunset.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find United Arab Emirates on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?
